Sleeping comfortably in warm sleeping bags made the outdoor camping adventure great.

desc.en: Actions happening right now.
desc.zh: 正在发生的动作。

rule.en: Use am/is/are + verb-ing to talk about actions happening right now.
rule.zh: 使用 am/is/are + 动词-ing 表示正在发生的动作。

desc.en: Past actions ending in -ed.
desc.zh: 过去发生的规则动作 (-ed)。

rule.en: Add '-ed' to regular verbs to talk about completed past events.
rule.zh: 规则动词末尾加 '-ed' 表示过去完成的事。

title.zh: 一般过去时：不规则动词

desc.en: Common irregular past verbs (went, ate, saw).
desc.zh: 常见不规则过去式动词。

rule.en: Irregular verbs change form in the past tense (go -> went, eat -> ate, see -> saw, buy -> bought).
rule.zh: 不规则动词过去式改变形式（如 go->went, eat->ate, see->saw）。

questions.q: Yesterday, we ___ to the zoo.

title.zh: 过去进行时：Was 与 Were

desc.en: Was and Were for actions in progress in the past.
desc.zh: 使用 Was / Were 表示过去正在进行的动作。

rule.en: Use 'was' with singular subjects (I, he, she, it) and 'were' with plural subjects (we, you, they).
rule.zh: 单数主语（I/He/She/It）用 was，复数主语（We/You/They）用 were。

questions.q: The chickens ___ running across the farmyard.
I ___ writing a letter at 8 PM yesterday.
The boys ___ playing football in the rain.

We ___ studying together all evening.
The cat ___ chasing a mouse under the table.
They ___ waiting for the bus at 7 AM.

desc.en: Compare two people, animals, or things.
desc.zh: 比较两个人或事物。

rule.en: Add '-er' to short adjectives (taller, faster) and use 'more' before long adjectives (more beautiful).
rule.zh: 短形容词加 '-er'，多音节形容词前加 'more'。

questions.q: An elephant is ___ than a dog.
Tom is ___ than his younger brother.
A sports car is ___ than a bicycle.
This flower is ___ than that one.
My house is ___ than yours.
English is ___ than math for me.

desc.en: Compare three or more things.
desc.zh: 三个或以上事物的最高级比较。

rule.en: Use 'the -est' for short adjectives (the tallest) and 'the most' for long adjectives (the most famous).
rule.zh: 短形容词前加 the，词尾加 -est；长形容词前加 the most。

questions.q: Jupiter is the ___ planet in our solar system.

desc.en: Use me, him, her, us, and them after verbs.
desc.zh: 动词后使用 me, him, her, us, them。

rule.en: Object pronouns (me, him, her, it, us, them) receive the action of a verb.
rule.zh: 宾格代词（me, him, her, us, them）充当动词的宾语。

questions.q: Please help ___ with this heavy box.

desc.zh: 学习 mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs。

rule.en: Possessive pronouns stand alone without a noun (This bag is mine).
rule.zh: 名词性物主代词单独使用，不带名词（如 This bag is mine）。

questions.q: This pen belongs to me. It is ___.

rule.en: Place frequency adverbs before main verbs, but after 'be' verbs.

title.en: Prepositions of Time: At, On, In

desc.en: Use at for times, on for days, in for months/years.
desc.zh: At 接时刻，On 接具体日期，In 接月份/年份。

rule.en: Use 'at' for clock times (at 8 AM), 'on' for days/dates (on Monday), and 'in' for months/years (in July).
rule.zh: 'at' 接具体点钟，'on' 接具体星期和日期，'in' 接月份、年份和季节。

questions.q: Our class starts ___ 8:00 AM.

desc.en: Many, much, some, and any.
desc.zh: Many, much, some, any 的辨析使用。

rule.en: Use 'many' with countable plural nouns and 'much' with uncountable nouns. Use 'some' in positive statements.
rule.zh: 'many' 修饰复数可数名词，'much' 修饰不可数名词，肯定句用 'some'。

questions.q: How ___ apples are on the table?

title.en: Future Tense: Will vs Going To
title.zh: 将来时：Will 与 Going to

desc.en: Express future plans and predictions.
desc.zh: 表达将来计划与预测。

rule.en: Use 'will' for spontaneous decisions/promises and 'be going to' for planned actions.
rule.zh: 'will' 用于临时决定/承诺，'be going to' 用于打算好的计划。

questions.q: Tomorrow, I ___ visit my grandparents.

title.en: Conjunctions: And, But, Or, So, Because
title.zh: 连词：And, But, Or, So, Because

desc.en: Join clauses and sentences together.
desc.zh: 连接分句与句子。

rule.en: Use 'and' for addition, 'but' for contrast, 'or' for choices, 'because' for reasons, and 'so' for results.
rule.zh: 'and' 递进，'but' 转折，'or' 选择，'because' 因果，'so' 结果。

questions.q: I like apples ___ I like bananas.
He ran fast, ___ he missed the bus.
I stayed at home ___ it was raining.

He was tired, ___ he went to bed early.

desc.en: Must for strong rules, should for advice.
desc.zh: Must 表示必须，Should 表示建议。

rule.en: Use 'must' for strong obligation/rules and 'should' for friendly advice.
rule.zh: 'must' 表示强烈的规则/义务，'should' 表示建议。

questions.q: You ___ stop when the traffic light is red.

Drivers ___ obey the speed limit.

We ___ protect environment for our future.

desc.en: Myself, yourself, himself, herself.
desc.zh: 学习 myself, yourself, himself, herself。

rule.en: Use reflexive pronouns when the subject and object are the same person.
rule.zh: 当主语和宾语为同一人时使用反身代词。

questions.q: He taught ___ how to play guitar.

I made this cake all by ___.

writing.en: If you could have any superpower for one day, what would it be? How would you use it to help others?
writing.zh: 如果你能拥有一天的超能力，你想要什么？你会如何使用它来帮助别人？

writing.en: Imagine you found a secret door in your bedroom. Where does it lead to and what do you see?
writing.zh: 想象你在卧室里发现了一扇秘密门。它通向哪里，你在那里看到了什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite hobby? Why do you enjoy doing it in your free time?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的爱好是什么？为什么你喜欢在空闲时间做这件事？

writing.en: If you could invent a helpful robot, what would it look like? What chores would it do for you?
writing.zh: 如果你能发明一个有用的机器人，它长什么样？它会帮你做哪些家务？

writing.en: Describe your dream treehouse. What fun games and rooms would you put inside?
writing.zh: 描述一下你梦想中的树屋。你会在里面放哪些有趣的游戏和房间？

writing.en: If you were a famous explorer, where would you go? What mysterious things would you discover?
writing.zh: 如果你是一位著名的探险家，你想去哪里？你会发现什么神秘的东西？

writing.en: Write a story about a pet that can talk. What funny things would your pet say to you?
writing.zh: 写一个关于会说话的宠物的故事。你的宠物会对你说什么有趣的话？

writing.en: Imagine you could travel into outer space. Which planet would you visit and who would you take with you?
writing.zh: 想象你可以去外太空旅行。你想去哪个星球，你会带谁一起去？

writing.en: Who is your best friend? What are three fun things you love to do together?
writing.zh: 谁是你最好的朋友？你们最喜欢一起做的三件有趣的事情是什么？

writing.en: If it rained your favorite food instead of water, what food would it be? How would you collect it?
writing.zh: 如果天上下的不是雨而是你最喜欢的食物，那会是什么？你会怎么把它们收集起来？

writing.en: What is the best gift you ever received? Why is it special to you?
writing.zh: 你收到的最好的礼物是什么？它为什么对你很特别？

writing.en: If you could talk to any ocean animal, which one would it be? What would you ask them?
writing.zh: 如果你能和任何海洋动物说话，你想和哪种说话？你会问他们什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite family tradition? What makes it so fun for everyone?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的家庭传统是什么？是什么让大家觉得这么有趣？

writing.en: Imagine you spent a day living in a cartoon world. What cartoon would it be and what would you do?
writing.zh: 想象你在卡通世界里生活了一天。那会是哪个卡通，你会做什么？

writing.en: If you had a magic carpet, where would you fly first? What would you see from the sky?
writing.zh: 如果你有一块魔毯，你会先飞去哪里？你从天上会看到什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite game to play with your family? Why is it so exciting?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢和家人玩什么游戏？为什么它这么令人兴奋？

writing.en: If you could change one school rule, what rule would you change? What would the new rule be?
writing.zh: 如果你能改变一条学校规则，你会改变哪一条？新的规则会是什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite meal that your parents cook? Why do you like it so much?
writing.zh: 你父母做的饭菜里你最喜欢哪一道？为什么你这么喜欢它？

writing.en: If you found a magic lamp with three wishes, what would your first wish be? Why?
writing.zh: 如果你发现了一个可以满足三个愿望的神灯，你的第一个愿望会是什么？为什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite movie or TV show? Who is your favorite character in it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的电影或电视节目是什么？里面你最喜欢的角色是谁？

writing.en: If you could build a house out of candy, what sweets would you use for the walls and roof?
writing.zh: 如果你能用糖果建一座房子，你会用什么甜食来做墙壁和屋顶？

writing.en: What is your favorite outdoor activity in spring? How does it make you feel?
writing.zh: 春天你最喜欢的户外活动是什么？它让你感觉怎么样？

writing.en: If you had a pet dragon, what would you name it? Where would you take your dragon to play?
writing.zh: 如果你有一只宠物龙，你会给它取什么名字？你会带你的龙去哪里玩？

writing.en: What is your favorite thing about your school classroom? What makes your classroom special?
writing.zh: 关于你的学校教室，你最喜欢什么？是什么让你的教室很特别？

writing.en: If you could grow any plant in a magic garden, what would grow on the branches?
writing.zh: 如果你能在魔法花园里种植任何植物，树枝上会长出什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite sport or physical activity? What do you like most about it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的体育活动是什么？你最喜欢它的什么？

writing.en: If you could travel back in time, what historical place or event would you visit?
writing.zh: 如果你能穿越回过去，你会去游览哪个历史地方或事件？

writing.en: What is your favorite dessert to eat at a party? Why is it your top choice?
writing.zh: 在派对上你最喜欢吃什么甜点？为什么它是你的首选？

writing.en: Imagine you could talk to birds. What news would they bring you from the sky?
writing.zh: 想象你能和鸟儿说话。它们会从天上为你带来什么消息？

writing.en: What is your favorite place to relax when you are tired? What do you do there?
writing.zh: 当你累的时候你最喜欢在哪里放松？你在那里做什么？

writing.en: If you could design a new playground slide, what shape and color would it be?
writing.zh: 如果你能设计一个新的游乐场滑梯，它会是什么形状和颜色？

writing.en: What is your favorite thing to do on a rainy afternoon indoors?
writing.zh: 下雨的下午在室内你最喜欢做什么？

writing.en: If you could turn invisible for one hour, where would you hide and what would you do?
writing.zh: 如果你能隐形一小时，你会藏在哪里，会做什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite sea animal to see at the aquarium? Why do you like it?
writing.zh: 在水族馆你最喜欢看什么海洋动物？你为什么喜欢它？

writing.en: If you were the teacher for one day, what fun lesson would you teach your class?
writing.zh: 如果你能当一天老师，你会给全班上一堂什么有趣的课？

writing.en: What is your favorite memory from a past vacation? Who was there with you?
writing.zh: 过去假期里你最美好的回忆是什么？当时谁和你在一起？

writing.en: If you could open a small shop, what cool things would you sell inside?
writing.zh: 如果你能开一家小店，你会卖哪些酷炫的东西？

writing.en: What is your favorite fruit juice or drink? How often do you get to drink it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的果汁或饮料是什么？你多久能喝一次？

writing.en: If your pet could wear clothes, what costume would you dress them in?
writing.zh: 如果你的宠物能穿衣服，你会给他们穿什么服装？

writing.en: What is your favorite thing about camping under the stars? What food would you cook?
writing.zh: 在星空下露营你最喜欢什么？你会做什么食物？

writing.en: If you found a glowing treasure chest, what magical item would be inside?
writing.zh: 如果你发现了一个发光的宝箱，里面会有什么神奇的物品？

writing.en: What is your favorite board game or card game? Why is it fun to win?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的桌游或纸牌游戏是什么？为什么赢了很有趣？

writing.en: If you could build a giant snow castle in winter, who would help you build it?
writing.zh: 如果你能在冬天建一座巨型雪城堡，谁会帮你建造？

writing.en: What is your favorite song to listen to when you are happy? Why do you like the music?
writing.zh: 当你高兴的时候你最喜欢听什么歌？你为什么喜欢这音乐？

writing.en: If you could shrink down to the size of an ant, what places would you explore?
writing.zh: 如果你能缩到蚂蚁那么大，你会探索什么地方？

writing.en: What is your favorite season of the year? What do you love doing during that season?
writing.zh: 一年中你最喜欢的季节是什么？你在那个季节最喜欢做什么？

writing.en: If you had a magic pencil that brought drawings to life, what would you draw first?
writing.zh: 如果你有一支能让画作变活的神奇铅笔，你会先画什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite subject at school? What new things did you learn recently?
writing.zh: 学校里你最喜欢的科目是什么？你最近学到了什么新知识？

writing.en: If you could build your own bicycle, what color and cool features would it have?
writing.zh: 如果你能组装自己的自行车，它会有什么颜色和酷炫的功能？

text.en: The Martinez family had a weekend yard sale to clean their garage. They cleaned old toys and put small price tags on storybooks. Family members set out clothes on racks and put games on tables. Neighbors came by all morning to buy good items at low prices. Giving earned money to help sick kids made their work feel good.
text.zh: 马丁内斯一家举办了周末庭院售卖来清理车库。他们清洗旧玩具，在故事书上贴小价格标签。家人们在架子上摆放衣服，在桌子上放游戏。邻居们整个早晨都来低价购买好物品。把赚来的钱拿去帮助生病的孩子，让他们的工作感觉很好。

text.en: Chloe took a swim class at the pool to get better at swimming. Her teacher showed how to breathe right and kick feet hard. Students practiced diving safely off starting blocks into six-foot water. Chloe built strong arms by swimming laps across the pool every day. Passing the final test gave Chloe a real swimmer badge to wear.
text.zh: 克洛伊在泳池上了游泳课，以变得更擅长游泳。她的老师演示了如何正确呼吸和用力踢脚。学生们练习从起始台安全跳入六英尺深的水中。克洛伊每天通过在泳池中划水建立强壮的双臂。通过最终测试给克洛伊一枚真实的游泳者徽章来佩戴。

Teachers showed how to turn clay on wheels and make smooth round walls. After drying, students painted colors onto their custom bowls before baking. Bringing home shiny finished clay bowls filled students with creative joy.
text.zh: 4号教室的学生去上了陶艺课做泥罐。他们在板上按压软湿粘土清除气泡。老师们演示了如何在轮子上转动粘土，做光滑的圆墙。晾干后，学生们在定制的碗上涂上颜色，然后烘烤。把闪亮的成品泥碗带回家让学生们充满了创作的快乐。

text.en: The Nature Club spent Saturday morning watching wild birds in the park. Members brought glasses and bird books to spot local kinds by feather colors. They saw red birds, blue jays, and yellow birds near bird tables. The group wrote bird names in books and listened to morning songs. Learning how birds fly long ways gave children love for animals.
text.zh: 自然社团在周六早晨在公园观察野生鸟类。成员们带了眼镜和鸟类书，根据羽毛颜色发现当地物种。他们在鸟桌附近看到了红鸟、蓝鸟和黄鸟。小组在书上写下鸟名，倾听晨曲。了解到鸟类如何长途飞行给孩子们带来了对野生动物的爱。

desc.en: Have/Has + past participle for past actions with present relevance.
desc.zh: Have/Has + 过去分词表示过去发生且影响现在的动作。

rule.en: Use 'have/has' + past participle for past experiences or unfinished time periods.
rule.zh: 使用 'have/has' + 过去分词表达经历或尚未结束的时间段内的动作。

questions.q: I ___ finished my homework already.
She ___ lived in Beijing for five years.
They ___ visited the Great Wall twice.
He ___ lost his house key.
We ___ known each other since primary school.
___ you ever seen a panda in real life?
She ___ already read that adventure book.

title.zh: 现在完成时：For 与 Since

desc.en: For + duration, Since + starting point.
desc.zh: For 接一段时间，Since 接时间起点。

rule.en: Use 'for' to state a length of time (for 3 years) and 'since' for a specific starting moment (since 2020).
rule.zh: 'for' 后面接具体时间段，'since' 后面接时间起点。

questions.q: I have been here ___ two hours.
She has lived here ___ 2018.
We have known Tom ___ a long time.
He has been sick ___ last Monday.
They have played soccer ___ 30 minutes.
I haven't seen her ___ yesterday morning.
Mr. Wang has taught English ___ ten years.

desc.en: Had + past participle for an action before another past event.
desc.zh: Had + 过去分词表示在过去某一时间点之前已完成的动作。

rule.en: Use 'had' + past participle for an action completed before another past action.
rule.zh: 使用 'had' + 过去分词描述在另一个过去动作之前已完成的事（过去的过去）。

questions.q: When I arrived at the station, the train ___ left.
She ___ finished her dinner before the movie started.
By the time we got home, Mom ___ cooked meal.
He told me that he ___ lost his wallet.
They ___ lived in London before moving to Paris.
The sun ___ set before we reached the mountain top.
I realized that I ___ forgotten my notebook.

desc.en: Be + past participle (The book was written by...).
desc.zh: Be + 过去分词（焦点在动作承受者）。

rule.en: Use passive voice (be + past participle) when the focus is on the object receiving the action.
rule.zh: 当焦点在于动作承受者时使用被动语态（be + 过去分词）。

questions.q: The window ___ broken by the baseball yesterday.
English is ___ all over the world.
The bridge was ___ in 1995.
These letters were ___ by my sister.
The cake was ___ by my mom this morning.
The lost dog was ___ in the park.
The prize was ___ to the top student.

desc.en: If + present simple, will + base verb.
desc.zh: If + 一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。

rule.en: Use 'If + simple present, will + verb' for real future possibilities.
rule.zh: 表达将来的真实可能性：If 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。

questions.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ stay inside.
If you study hard, you ___ pass the exam.
If she ___ early, we will go together.
They will win the game if they ___ well.
If I see him, I ___ tell him the news.
We will have a picnic if the weather ___ nice.
If he ___ fast, he will catch the bus.

desc.en: If + past simple, would + base verb.
desc.zh: If + 过去时，主句用 would + 动词原形。

rule.en: Use 'If + simple past, would + verb' for imaginary or hypothetical situations.
rule.zh: 表达非真实或假设情况：If 从句用过去时，主句用 would + 动词原形。

questions.q: If I had a million dollars, I ___ buy a big boat.
If she ___ a bird, she would fly to Hawaii.
They would travel the world if they ___ rich.
If I ___ his number, I would call him.
He would help us if he ___ time.
If we lived near the beach, we ___ swim every day.
If you ___ harder, you would get better marks.

desc.en: Who for people, Which/That for things.
desc.zh: Who 代指人，Which/That 代指物。

rule.en: Use 'who' for people and 'which' or 'that' for things or animals.
rule.zh: 定语从句中修饰人用 'who'，修饰物或动物用 'which' 或 'that'。

questions.q: The girl ___ won the race is my friend.
The book ___ I bought yesterday is interesting.
This is the doctor ___ saved my dog.
Look at the car ___ is parked outside.
The boy ___ sits next to me is smart.
I love the sweater ___ you are wearing.
The place ___ we met was very quiet.

desc.en: Report what someone said.
desc.zh: 转述他人的话语。

rule.en: When reporting speech in the past, shift present tense verbs to past tense.
rule.zh: 转述过去的话语时，时态通常向过去推移（如 am/is -> was）。

questions.q: Tom said, 'I am tired.' -> Tom said that he ___ tired.
Mary said, 'I like ice cream.' -> Mary said that she ___ ice cream.
He said, 'We are ready.' -> He said that they ___ ready.
She told me, 'I will call you.' -> She told me that she ___ call me.
Ben said, 'I have finished.' -> Ben said that he ___ finished.
The teacher said that the sun ___ in the east.
They said, 'We can win.' -> They said that they ___ win.

desc.en: Verb + -ing vs To + base verb.
desc.zh: 动词-ing 与 To + 动词原形。

rule.en: Some verbs are followed by gerunds (enjoy reading) and others by infinitives (decide to go).
rule.zh: 部分动词后接动名词（如 enjoy doing），部分动词后接不定式（如 decide to do）。

questions.q: She enjoys ___ books on rainy days.
We decided ___ to Beijing by train.
He promised ___ me tomorrow.
They finished ___ their room at noon.
I want ___ a new song on guitar.
Avoid ___ noise in the study hall.
She hopes ___ a doctor in the future.

desc.en: Confirm information at the end of a sentence.
desc.zh: 句末附加疑问成分确认信息。

rule.en: Use negative question tags after positive statements, and positive tags after negative statements.
rule.zh: 前肯后否，前否后肯（如 You are ready, aren't you?）。

questions.q: You are a student, ___ you?
He is very smart, ___ he?
They don't like milk, ___ they?
She can play piano, ___ she?
You haven't seen Tom today, ___ you?
We passed the exam, ___ we?
It is a beautiful day, ___ it?

title.en: Modals of Deduction: Must / Can't / Might

desc.en: Express how certain you are about something.
desc.zh: 表达对事件确信程度的推测。

rule.en: Use 'must be' when 100% sure something is true, and 'can't be' when 100% sure it is impossible.
rule.zh: 'must be' 表示肯定推测（一定是），'can't be' 表示否定推测（不可能）。

questions.q: He has three sports cars. He ___ be very rich.
That ___ be Mary. She is in London today!
Take an umbrella. It ___ rain later.
She has studied all day. She ___ be tired.
You just ate lunch! You ___ be hungry already.
He is not answering. He ___ be asleep.
The lights are off. They ___ be at home.

desc.en: Express contrast (although) vs reason (because).
desc.zh: 表达转折让步（although）与原因（because）。

rule.en: Use 'although' for surprising contrast and 'because' for explanations.
rule.zh: 'although' 表示尽管（转折让步），'because' 表示因为（原因解释）。

questions.q: ___ it was raining, he went out without an umbrella.
I stayed at home ___ I felt sick.
___ she was tired, she kept working hard.
He passed the test ___ he studied thoroughly.
___ he is young, he is very wise.
We enjoyed the picnic ___ the wind was chilly.
They won the match ___ they practiced together.

desc.en: Singular subjects take singular verbs.
desc.zh: 单数主语用单数谓语，复数用复数。

rule.en: Words like 'everyone', 'each', and 'neither' take singular verbs (is, has, runs).
rule.zh: 包含 everyone, each, neither 等不定代词作为主语时用单数谓语动词。

questions.q: Everyone in the class ___ happy today.
Each of the boys ___ a new bike.
Neither of the answers ___ correct.
One of my friends ___ living in Paris.
The group of students ___ walking to school.
Everyone ___ to win the game.
Neither Tom nor his brothers ___ present.

desc.en: Make/let someone do something.
desc.zh: 让/使某人做某事（使役句型）。

rule.en: Use make/let/have + object + base verb (without 'to').
rule.zh: 使用 make/let/have + 宾语 + 动词原形（不带 to）。

questions.q: Mom made me ___ my bedroom.
The teacher let us ___ outside early.
Please have him ___ me back.
Don't let the dog ___ out.
He made his sister ___.
Our boss made us ___ late yesterday.
Let me ___ you with your bag.

desc.en: Never have I seen... for strong emphasis.
desc.zh: 否定副词置于句首时的部分倒装。

rule.en: When a sentence starts with negative adverbs (Never, Seldom), invert subject and auxiliary verb.
rule.zh: 否定副词（Never, Seldom）置于句首时，主语和助动词倒装。

questions.q: Never ___ I seen such a beautiful sunrise.
Seldom ___ he visit the museum.
Not only ___ she smart, but she is also kind.
Little ___ they know about the surprise party.
Never ___ we heard such a loud sound.
Hardly ___ I arrived when the phone rang.
Rarely ___ she eat fast food.

writing.en: If you could invent a fun tool to help students study, what would it be? How would it make learning easier?
writing.zh: 如果你能发明一个帮助学生学习的有趣工具，那会是什么？它会如何让学习变得更容易？

writing.en: What is your dream job when you grow up? Why do you find this career exciting?
writing.zh: 你长大后梦想的工作是什么？为什么你觉得这个职业很令人兴奋？

writing.en: If you could design a new amusement park, what would be the main theme? What exciting rides would you build?
writing.zh: 如果你能设计一个新的游乐园，主题会是什么？你会建造哪些刺激的游乐设施？

writing.en: If you had a personal helper robot for one week, what tasks would you ask it to do? Why?
writing.zh: 如果你有一周的私人助手机器人，你会让它做什么任务？为什么？

writing.en: Describe an ideal eco-friendly school. What special green features would your school have?
writing.zh: 描述一所理想的环保学校。你的学校会有什么特别的绿色环保特色？

writing.en: Do you think playing team sports is good for students? How does teamwork help us make friends?
writing.zh: 你认为做团队运动对学生有好处吗？团队合作如何帮助我们交朋友？

writing.en: Describe your dream bedroom of the future. What cool technology and furniture would you put inside?
writing.zh: 描述一下你梦想中未来的卧室。你会在里面摆放什么酷炫的技术和家具？

writing.en: If you could have any superpower to protect the environment, what power would you choose? How would you use it?
writing.zh: 如果你能拥有保护环境的超能力，你会选择什么能力？你会如何使用它？

writing.en: If you could design a new smartphone game, what would the player's main mission be?
writing.zh: 如果你能设计一款新的智能手机游戏，玩家的主要任务会是什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite way to learn new things online? Why do you prefer this method?
writing.zh: 在网上学习新事物你最喜欢的方式是什么？为什么你更喜欢这种方法？

writing.en: If you were the school principal for one day, what special event would you plan for the students?
writing.zh: 如果你能当一天的校长，你会为学生们规划什么特别的活动？

writing.en: What is your favorite book series or novel? Why is the main character memorable?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的系列丛书或小说是什么？为什么主人公令人难忘？

writing.en: If you could visit any country in the world, where would you go? What famous sights would you see?
writing.zh: 如果你能去世界上任何国家，你想去哪里？你会看哪些著名的景点？

writing.en: What is a good habit you have built this year? How has it helped you in daily life?
writing.zh: 今年你养成了什么好习惯？它在日常生活里怎么帮到了你？

writing.en: If you could create a new flavor of soft drink, what fruits and ingredients would you blend?
writing.zh: 如果你能调配一种新口味的软饮料，你会混合什么水果和配料？

writing.en: Describe an unforgettable school trip you took. What was the most exciting part?
writing.zh: 描述一次令人难忘的学校郊游。最让人兴奋的部分是什么？

writing.en: If you could build a futuristic vehicle, would it fly, sail, or drive? How fast would it travel?
writing.zh: 如果你能建造一部未来交通工具，它会飞、航行还是驾驶？它速度有多快？

writing.en: What is your favorite dish to help cook at home? Why do you enjoy preparing it?
writing.zh: 在家帮着做饭你最喜欢哪道菜？为什么你喜欢准备它？

writing.en: If you could meet any historical figure, who would it be? What main question would you ask them?
writing.zh: 如果你能见到任何历史人物，那会是谁？你会问他们的主要问题是什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite talent or skill? How do you practice to get better at it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的特长或技能是什么？你平时怎么练习来提高它？

writing.en: If you could design a new sport, what equipment would players use? What are the main rules?
writing.zh: 如果你能设计一项新的运动，选手们会使用什么装备？主要规则是什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite memory of a holiday celebration with family?
writing.zh: 关于和家人一起过节，你最美好的回忆是什么？

writing.en: If you could spend a week living on a tropical island, what activities would you do each day?
writing.zh: 如果你能在热带岛屿上生活一周，你每天会做哪些活动？

writing.en: What is the best piece of advice a teacher or parent gave you? How did it help you?
writing.zh: 老师或父母给过你最好的建议是什么？它怎么帮到了你？

writing.en: If you could build your own space station, what research labs and fun rooms would you include?
writing.zh: 如果你能建造自己的空间站，你会包含哪些科研实验室和娱乐房间？

writing.en: What is your favorite outdoor sport or game in summer? Why do you love playing it?
writing.zh: 夏天你最喜欢的户外运动或游戏是什么？你为什么喜欢玩它？

writing.en: If you could turn any book into a movie, which book would you pick? Who would play the hero?
writing.zh: 如果你能把任何一本书拍成电影，你会选哪本？谁来扮演主角？

writing.en: What is your favorite restaurant meal? What makes that food so delicious?
writing.zh: 在餐厅里你最喜欢吃的一餐是什么？是什么让那食物这么美味？

writing.en: If you had a time machine that only traveled into the future, what year would you visit?
writing.zh: 如果你有一台只能去未来的时间机器，你会去参观哪一年？

writing.en: What is your favorite thing about working on a group project with classmates?
writing.zh: 关于和同班同学一起做小组课题，你最喜欢什么？

writing.en: If you could create a new festival for your city, what would people eat and celebrate?
writing.zh: 如果你能为你的城市设立一个新的节日，人们会吃什么、庆祝什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite music genre or instrument? How does listening to music help you relax?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的音乐类型或乐器是什么？听音乐怎么帮到你放松？

writing.en: If you could adopt any wild animal as a pet, what animal would you choose? How would you care for it?
writing.zh: 如果你能领养任何野生动物做宠物，你会选哪种？你会怎么照顾它？

writing.en: What is your favorite museum exhibit you have seen? What interesting facts did you learn?
writing.zh: 你看过最喜欢的博物馆展品是什么？你学到了哪些有趣的知识？

writing.en: If you could build a secret hideout in the forest, what supplies and tools would you bring?
writing.zh: 如果你能在森林里建一个秘密据点，你会带什么物资和工具？

writing.en: What is the most useful thing you learned in science class this year?
writing.zh: 今年科学课上你学到的最用得上的知识是什么？

writing.en: If you could direct a comedy movie, what funny event would happen to the main characters?
writing.zh: 如果你能导演一部喜剧电影，主角们会发生什么搞笑的事？

writing.en: What is your favorite place to go with your best friends? What do you do there?
writing.zh: 你和好朋友们最喜欢去的地方是什么？你们在那里做什么？

writing.en: If you could change the school menu, what healthy meals would you add for lunch?
writing.zh: 如果你能更改学校菜单，午餐你会增加什么健康的菜肴？

writing.en: What is your favorite memory from a school sports day? How did your team do?
writing.zh: 关于学校运动会你最美好的回忆是什么？你们队表现怎么样？

writing.en: If you could explore the ocean floor in a mini-submarine, what deep sea creatures would you photograph?
writing.zh: 如果你能坐微型潜水艇探索海底，你会拍哪些深海生物？

writing.en: What is your favorite board game strategy? Why do you enjoy playing it with friends?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的桌游策略是什么？为什么你喜欢和朋友们玩它？

writing.en: If you could build a giant robot to clean up trash in your town, how would it work?
writing.zh: 如果你能建造一个巨型机器人清理小镇的垃圾，它会怎么工作？

writing.en: What is your favorite story from history class? Why do you find it interesting?
writing.zh: 历史课上你最喜欢的故事是什么？为什么你觉得它很有趣？

writing.en: If you could visit the moon for one weekend, what space games would you play in zero gravity?
writing.zh: 如果你能在月球上度过一个周末，你会玩什么失重太空游戏？

writing.en: What is your favorite kind of art or craft project? What colors do you love using?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的艺术或手工项目是什么？你喜欢使用什么颜色？
